ink.$description: Text on every light and pastel surface (brand guide secondary #020A13; 8:1 or better on all bg-* colours). Headings, body, table text.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, footers, captions, source lines (brand guide secondary #22364C; 6:1 or better on bg-sky and lighter).

slate.$description: Brand guide secondary #7D8E9F. Rules, icons, disabled states and chart neutrals. Not for text: 3.3:1 on surface-card.

navy.$description: Dark cards, the highlighted MailerCloud node in diagrams, emphasis pills, bar fills and report table headers (brand guide secondary #091929). Text on it is surface-card or white.

brand-blue.$description: Primary brand colour #046DFF (brand guide). The logo cloud, the header rule, links, the one highlighted chart bar and the new-route arrows. Contrast is 4.4:1 on white and surface-card (just under AA for small text), 3.5:1 on bg-lime and 2.1:1 on bg-sky: use it for large text, graphics and the logo, underline any link, and use navy on bg-sky.

surface-card.$description: Cards, diagram nodes and pinned panels on top of pastel grounds. Ink text.

surface-tint.$description: Summary boxes at the top of a report page. Ink text.

surface-zebra.$description: Alternate table rows and KPI tiles on white report pages. Ink text.

bg-sky.$description: Cover, closing and data-flow slide grounds. The brand's lead background. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-lime.$description: Slide ground for context and decision slides; also pill fill on white cards. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-mint.$description: Slide ground for comparison and capability slides. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-green.$description: Slide ground for capacity and numbers slides; the 'no change' pill. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-pink.$description: Slide ground for options and proof slides. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-cream.$description: Slide ground for diagrams and charts that need a quiet field. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-yellow.$description: Rare high-energy ground from the company overview (Drag and drop builder page). Use for at most one slide in a deck. Marketing-collateral colour (company overview PDF); not listed in the brand guide.

bg-paper.$description: Near-white ground for text-heavy slides (security, policy) and the page ground for reports.

line.$description: Table rules, footer rules and card outlines on white pages.

attention-bg.$description: Rows and callouts that need a closer look. Always paired with a text label such as 'Worth a closer look'.

positive-bg.$description: Confirmation pills and the 'unchanged' row in a table.

success.$description: Brand guide behaviour colour for success. Status dots, confirmation icons, positive deltas. Text on it is ink.

error.$description: Brand guide behaviour colour for error. Failures and blocking states. Text on it is ink (4.8:1); white is only 4.2:1, so use white on it for large text only.

warning.$description: Brand guide behaviour colour for warning. Attention markers and icons. Text on it is ink. attention-bg is its tint.

info.$description: Brand guide behaviour colour for information. Info banners and highlights. Text on it is ink.

chart-grey.$description: The comparison or previous-period bar in a chart (alias of slate).

chart-light.$description: The residual 'all other' segment in a stacked bar.

code-key.$description: JSON keys on navy code cards.

code-string.$description: JSON string values on navy code cards.

code-text.$description: Punctuation and plain text on navy code cards.

text-primary.$description: Semantic. Default text colour. Alias of ink.

text-secondary.$description: Semantic. Captions, footers, source lines. Alias of ink-muted.

text-inverse.$description: Semantic. Text on navy and other inverse surfaces.

text-link.$description: Semantic. Links. Always underlined because brand-blue is 4.4:1 on white.

surface-page.$description: Semantic. Page ground for reports and text-heavy slides.

surface-raised.$description: Semantic. Cards and diagram nodes above a page or pastel ground.

surface-inverse.$description: Semantic. Dark cards, the MailerCloud node and code cards.

border-subtle.$description: Semantic. Table rules and footer hairlines.

border-strong.$description: Semantic. Diagram node outlines and the connector lines of existing paths.

action-primary.$description: Semantic. The main call-to-action colour on white grounds.

focus-ring.$description: Semantic. Keyboard focus outline on interactive artefacts, 3px, offset 2px.

status-success.$description: Semantic. Success indicators. Pair with the word.

status-warning.$description: Semantic. Warning indicators. Pair with the word.

status-error.$description: Semantic. Error indicators. Pair with the word.

status-info.$description: Semantic. Information indicators. Pair with the word.

card-inverse-bg.$description: Component. Fill of the dark Card and CodeCard.

table-header-bg.$description: Component. Header row of the DataTable.

table-row-alt-bg.$description: Component. Alternate DataTable row on white pages.

node-inverse-bg.$description: Component. Fill of the MailerCloud DiagramNode.

chart-1.$description: Data visualisation, series 1 and the default bar.

chart-2.$description: Data visualisation, series 2 and the highlighted bar.

chart-3.$description: Data visualisation, series 3 and comparison values.

chart-4.$description: Data visualisation, series 4. Label directly; it is close to chart-5 in lightness.

space-1.$description: Gap between a pill and its neighbour; gap between stacked cards' small elements.

space-2.$description: Gap inside a card between heading and body; gap between title and subtitle.

space-card-tight.$description: Card padding when five cards sit across a slide (rollout plan).

space-4.$description: Gap between side-by-side cards; card padding on dense slides.

space-5.$description: Gap between a slide title and its content; card padding on sparse slides.

space-margin.$description: Slide margin on all four sides (bottom 160px when a footer row is present).

space-logo-top.$description: Distance from the top edge of a slide to the logo. The logo is 45px tall, so it ends at 101px and leaves 51px before the eyebrow at 152px.

space-footer.$description: Distance from the bottom edge of a slide to the footer row (url left, page number right, 24px).

space-title-top.$description: Distance from the top edge of a content slide to the eyebrow line; the title follows 8px below.

space-content-bottom.$description: Bottom padding of a content slide: content ends at y 880, leaving the footer band clear.

radius-round.$description: Discs, icon circles and the decorative circles on covers.

shadow-card.$description: White cards on pastel grounds. A hard offset shadow with no blur.
